blocks.text: Runaway Cinemalaya hit “Mag-Iina” (2026) will round off the spectacular line-up of films at the inaugural Sightlines Film Lab & Showcase, helmed by Sightlines Actors’ Space. Sightlines Actors’ Space is an international acting school based in the Philippines. In celebration of its fifth anniversary (and of burgeoning Filipino talent), the acting school is hosting the Sightlines Film Lab & Showcase, a multi-day event featuring film screenings, talks, and masterclasses. The event will draw some of the best and brightest talents in the Philippine film industry into a creative hub that bridges the gap between talents in front of the camera and […]...
